# Living Design System — Tokens [![Build Status](https://ci.falcon.walmart.com/buildStatus/icon?job=LivingDesign%2Ftokens)](https://ci.falcon.walmart.com/job/LivingDesign/job/tokens/)

Living Design System's design tokens.

## Getting started

```shell
# With yarn
yarn add -D @livingdesign/tokens

# With npm
npm install -D @livingdesign/tokens
```

## Usage

Tokens are built in several formats (CSS, SCSS, JS, JSON, React Native).

### Regular scale

#### CSS

```css
@import "@livingdesign/tokens/dist/css/light/regular/globals.css";
```

#### JavaScript

```js
import * as globalTokens from "@livingdesign/tokens/dist/js/light/regular/globals.js";
```

#### JSON

```js
const globalTokens = require("@livingdesign/tokens/dist/json/light/regular/globals.json");
```

#### Sass

```scss
@use "~@livingdesign/tokens/dist/scss/light/regular/globals";
```

#### React Native

```js
import * as globalTokens from "@livingdesign/tokens/dist/react-native/light/regular/globals.json";
```

### Mega scale

Mega is Living Design's scaled-up experience for larger screen where the regular scale is too small for users. It applies to global tokens' and component tokens' values, but it doesn't modify tokens' names or components' features.

Mega's scale factor is applied consistently to global and component tokens:

* Breakpoints: no scale changes
* Border and separator widths: 200% scale increase
* All other dimensions (font, elevation, size, etc.): 150% scale increase

To use Mega tokens, replace `regular` with `mega` in the import path.

#### CSS

```css
@import "@livingdesign/tokens/dist/css/light/mega/globals.css";
```

#### JavaScript

```js
import * as globalTokens from "@livingdesign/tokens/dist/js/light/mega/globals.js";
```

#### JSON

```js
const globalTokens = require("@livingdesign/tokens/dist/json/light/mega/globals.json");
```

#### Sass

```scss
@use "~@livingdesign/tokens/dist/scss/light/mega/globals";
```

#### React Native

```js
import * as globalTokens from "@livingdesign/tokens/dist/react-native/light/mega/globals.json";
```
